page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 56 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 224.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units, providing a combined total of 16 GB of video RAM (VRAM). This server does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options.

Operating on the KVM hypervisor, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile balances a high count of dedicated x86_64 vCPUs with dual entry-level NVIDIA P4 GPUs, offering a resource-dense configuration for workloads that require parallel processing without the premium cost of high-end tensor-core accelerators. This configuration is suited for workloads such as video transcoding, low-latency inference, parallel computing, and general-purpose GPU-accelerated tasks.
